translation: He also said: The disease of the Yang Wei is suffering from chills and fever, and the disease of the Yin Wei is suffering from heart pain. (Rongrong means the appearance of slowness.) Zhang Jiegu said: wei is yang and governs the exterior; when the Yang Wei receives pathogenic [influence], the disease is in the exterior, and therefore there is suffering from chills and fever. ying is yin and governs the interior; when the Yin Wei receives pathogenic [influence], the disease is in the interior, and therefore there is suffering from heart pain. When yin and yang bind each other, then ying and wei are harmonious; but when ying and wei are not harmonious, then [the person] is disconsolate and loses his resolve, unable to gather and control himself.
